newsitem.title: USA: Principal to acquire UAP units in Chile.
newsitem.headline: Principal to acquire UAP units in Chile.

text.p: Principal International Inc said it has a letter of understanding with Union des Assurances de Paris (UAP) to acquire UAP International-Chile and its subsidiaries, UAP Seguros de Vida Chile SA and UAP Seguros Generales Chile SA.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed. The deal was expected to close in about 45 days, Principal said.
Principal International, a unit of Principal Financial Group based in Des Moines, Iowa, and its Chilean joint venture partner BanMedica SA will collaborate in the management of the companies.
Finalization of the acquisition is subject to completion of the terms and conditions of the agreement and authorization by the Chilean insurance authorities, Principal said.
UAP International Chile subsidiaries provide life, health and property-casualty insurance products, Principal said.
Those products will complement Principal's existing health, annuities, employee benefits and individual insurance services currently administered by Principal International and BanMedica.
"Our intent is to continue, together with BanMedica, the active growth of our operations in Chile," Camilio Salazar, vice president at Principal International said in a statement.
Principal International was formed by Principal Financial Group in 1990 to develop business opportunities outside the United States.
The company began a joint venture, BanRenta Compania de Seguros de Vida SA, with BanMedica in Chile in 1995.
The company also opened subsidiaries in Spain in 1991, Mexico in 1993, and Argentina and Indonesia in 1994.
"This acquisition is another element of our long-term strategy with BanMedica in Chile," said Jan Jobe, president of Principal International.
Principal Financial Group's Principal Mutual Life Insurance Co is the eighth largest U.S. life insurance co in assets and the 29th largest in the world.
